chunks: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than I in speech, so send him with me as a helper to affirm me, for I fear that they will call me a liar.

key_terms.يُكَذِّبُونِ: They will call me a liar

ai.seo_question: Why did Prophet Moses ask for Aaron to accompany him?
ai.summary: Although this verse is traditionally cited from Surah Ta-Ha (20:25-28) regarding Prophet Moses (AS) and Aaron (AS), the provided summary incorrectly attributes it to Surah Hud; in the Shia tradition, this dialogue highlights the divine selection of Aaron for his eloquence to complement Moses' prophethood. The request underscores the practical wisdom of using complementary strengths in leadership and serves as a precedent for the concept of 'Nass' (designation) in Imamate, where specific qualities are divinely appointed for guidance.
